name: nexformo-living-canvas
description: AI-powered real-time generative particle experience for Nexformo

scripts.build: node node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build && node node_modules/esbuild/bin/esbuild server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --packages=external --outfile=dist/server.cjs
scripts.test: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test tests/music.test.ts tests/weather.test.ts tests/solEmotion.test.ts tests/solMemory.test.ts tests/solMotion.test.ts tests/particleVolume.test.ts tests/privateBeta.test.ts tests/youtubePlayerLifecycle.test.ts
